reason: Yu Chun is in my guidebook and all over the Instagram posts I saved, and ice-cold naengmyeon on a hot Honolulu afternoon is exactly what I want. It is near Ala Moana, where I am shopping anyway, so I will go once on this trip.
objection: $18.95 before tax and tip for a bowl of noodles feels high, and I keep hearing you can get naengmyeon cheaper on Keeaumoku St. I only have a few days, so I do not want to waste a meal on something that is just famous.
